name: prettier-plugin-modelica
description: Prettier plugin for Modelica code formatting using tree-sitter

scripts.setup: cd grammars/tree-sitter-modelica && npm_config_allow_scripts= npm ci && npm_config_allow_scripts= npx tree-sitter generate && npx tree-sitter build --wasm . && cp tree-sitter-modelica.wasm ../../src/tree-sitter-modelica.wasm
scripts.build: tsc && cp src/tree-sitter-modelica.wasm dist/tree-sitter-modelica.wasm && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: Antoine Gautier <agautier@solamen.fr> (https://github.com/AntoineGautier)
